n: Hexapawn: a simple game to illustrate reinforced learning (Manchester)
t: A University of Manchester resource that uses hexapawn to show reinforcement learning.
steps: Find the University of Manchester hexapawn resource page.
Read how the drawer machine works. Search results say it needs at least 37 drawers to play black or 33 to play white.
Note that this drawer count was not verified from the page.
Decide between building the machine and using the class variant.
Plan about an hour for setup.
Play a practice game before class.
